scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev -- concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @kia./group dev" "pnpm --filter @kia./api dev"
scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @kia./permissions build && pnpm --filter @kia./brand build && pnpm --filter @kia./shared build && pnpm --filter @kia./platform build && pnpm --filter @kia./kia-academy build && pnpm --filter @kia./kia-event build
scripts.build: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @kia./api build && pnpm --filter @kia./group build
scripts.build:pages: pnpm build:libs && export GITHUB_PAGES=true && export NEXT_BASE_PATH=/${PAGES_REPO_NAME:-KIA-GROUP} && export NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://${PAGES_OWNER:-kia-mlz}.github.io/${PAGES_REPO_NAME:-KIA-GROUP} && export NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true && pnpm --filter @kia./group build
scripts.test: pnpm build:libs && pnpm -r test && node --test scripts/preflight-docker-env.test.mjs
scripts.docker:db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.docker:setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env.docker')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.docker.example','.env.docker'); console.log('Created .env.docker');} else {console.log('.env.docker already exists');}"
